description: Defines the OrderTotalSummary class, a data model representing the summary of order totals including subtotal, total, tax, and additional fees. It is used to encapsulate the order's financial summary after calculations.

classes.name: OrderTotalSummary
classes.description: A data container class for summarizing total order amounts, including subtotal, total, tax total, and list of other totals.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getTaxTotal
methods.description: Returns the total tax amount for the order.

methods.name: setTaxTotal
methods.description: Sets the total tax amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of other fees and totals.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of additional order totals and fees.
